map.：航程=航速×时间：15 节×10 小时=150 海里；折算公里约 277.8: : distance = speed x time: 15 knots x 10 hours = 150 nautical miles, which converts to about 277.8 km (1 nautical mile = 1.852 km). If the distance is 150 nautical miles and the speed limit 12 knots, it takes 12.5 hours.
